skill.name: notebooklm-manager
skill.description: Manage a local NotebookLM registry and query registered notebooks through a companion Chrome agent. Add, search, enable, disable, remove, and analyze notebook content.
skill.summary: Organize NotebookLM notebooks and retrieve covered answers through browser-assisted queries.
skill.author: LeeJuOh

security_audit.summary: All 64 static alerts are false positives caused by documented NotebookLM URLs, Markdown code formatting, app-owned storage paths, and ordinary lookup behavior. Context review found browser-agent prompt injection exposure, an unvalidated data-directory pointer, and spoofable response markers.

remediation.issue: User-controlled URLs and questions enter a browser-capable agent prompt without structural isolation.
remediation.suggestion: Validate NotebookLM hosts and paths, serialize input as data, and instruct the agent to reject embedded commands.

remediation.issue: The data-path locator can redirect later file operations to any absolute path.
remediation.suggestion: Resolve canonical paths, reject symlinks and paths outside approved plugin roots, and confirm migrations before writing.

remediation.issue: Reserved strings inside agent answers can trigger error or truncation branches.
remediation.suggestion: Return a validated status envelope and keep status fields separate from the untrusted NotebookLM answer.

semantic_findings.title: Untrusted Values Cross Browser-Agent Boundary
semantic_findings.description: The skill inserts a stored URL and user question into a free-form prompt for a browser-capable agent. Crafted values can add instructions and steer an authenticated browser outside the intended NotebookLM workflow.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Direct interpolation into a privileged agent prompt is explicit. The companion agent's unseen constraints may reduce exploitability, so confidence is high but not absolute.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Data Directory Pointer
semantic_findings.description: The skill trusts an absolute path from a fixed locator and applies it to later file operations. A tampered locator can redirect configuration and registry access outside plugin storage.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly trust an absolute path for all later operations. No canonicalization, symlink check, or approved-root validation is specified.

semantic_findings.title: Reserved Marker Injection in Agent Responses
semantic_findings.description: The workflow selects error and truncation branches by searching agent output for reserved strings. Notebook content containing those strings can spoof errors, suppress coverage, or mislead users.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The response table explicitly uses content markers for control flow. Exploitation depends on whether the agent preserves matching text from notebook answers.

content.user_title: Manage NotebookLM Research from Your AI Assistant
content.value_statement: Managing multiple NotebookLM notebooks and complete research queries is repetitive. This skill organizes the registry and delegates browser queries with bounded coverage checks.
actual_capabilities: Adds NotebookLM URLs with automatic title, topic, and description discovery.
Lists, searches, shows, enables, disables, and removes notebooks in a local registry.
Sends questions to registered notebooks through a companion Chrome browser agent.
Preserves chat history unless the user explicitly requests a fresh conversation.
Condenses questions above the configured length before submission.
Checks multi-topic answer coverage and launches bounded follow-up queries.
limitations: Requires the companion Chrome agent, Claude in Chrome extension, a running supported browser, and Google authentication.
Direct browser access is unavailable to this skill; all NotebookLM interactions depend on the companion agent.
Google interface changes can break selectors and clear-history behavior.
Native Codex use requires equivalent hooks, browser tooling, and data-path setup.

use_cases.title: Synthesize Research Topics
use_cases.description: Query a research notebook across several topics and fill coverage gaps with focused follow-ups.

use_cases.title: Find Technical Guidance
use_cases.description: Search documentation notebooks and retrieve a covered answer for an implementation question.

use_cases.title: Maintain a Notebook Catalog
use_cases.description: Add, search, archive, restore, and remove notebooks while keeping searchable local metadata.

prompt_templates.title: List Active Notebooks
prompt_templates.prompt: List my active NotebookLM notebooks with each notebook name, identifier, and topics.

prompt_templates.title: Search the Library
prompt_templates.prompt: Search my NotebookLM library for {topic}, then show the best matching notebook identifiers and descriptions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Find the right notebook before querying.

prompt_templates.title: Add and Query a Notebook
prompt_templates.prompt: Add {notebook_url} with Smart Add, then ask it: {question}. Keep the existing chat history.
prompt_templates.scenario: Register a new notebook and use it immediately.

prompt_templates.title: Run Coverage Follow-Ups
prompt_templates.prompt: Query {notebook_id} about {topics}. Check every topic, run at most {followup_count} focused follow-ups, then synthesize the results.
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a complete answer for a multi-topic request.

output: Claude Code Documentation: identifier claude-docs; topics include CLI, plugins, MCP, and hooks.
API Research: identifier api-research; topics include authentication, rate limits, and integrations.

output_examples.input: Search my notebooks for browser automation.
output_examples.output: Best match: Chrome Automation Notes. Identifier: chrome-automation. Topics: Chrome MCP, selectors, extension setup, and troubleshooting.

output_examples.input: Ask claude-docs about plugin hooks and installation scope.
output_examples.output: Notebook: Claude Code Documentation. Answer: Plugin hooks run around tool calls, while installation scope determines whether data is shared or project-specific.

best_practices: Use specific notebook identifiers and focused questions for more reliable answers.
Review condensed questions before relying on responses to large inputs.
Keep follow-up limits small and confirm before extending coverage analysis.
anti_patterns: Do not submit unrelated websites as NotebookLM notebook URLs.
Do not place secrets or privileged browser instructions inside notebook questions.
Do not clear chat history unless the user explicitly requests a fresh context.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Google account?
faq.answer: Yes. The browser must be signed in to Google with access to the requested NotebookLM notebooks.

faq.question: Does this skill control Chrome directly?
faq.answer: No. It delegates browser work to the companion chrome-mcp-query agent.

faq.question: Where is notebook metadata stored?
faq.answer: The companion hook resolves a local data directory for global or project-specific registry files.

faq.question: What happens when a question is too long?
faq.answer: The skill condenses the question, shows the shortened version, and suggests smaller queries when needed.

faq.question: Does the skill clear NotebookLM chat history?
faq.answer: It preserves history by default and clears it only after an explicit user request.

faq.question: Can Codex run this workflow without additional setup?
faq.answer: No. Codex needs equivalent hooks, browser-agent tooling, and data-path support for this Claude-oriented workflow.
